page.overview:
What is Amr?

The Amr is the leader of the Sorcerer Caste among the Assamite clan. Until recently the Amr was al-Ashrad, but after the schism of the Assamites, he was succeeded by his childe, Amaravati, who remained loyal to Ur-Shulgi.
